name: Cancellation Rebooking
content: When an airline cancels a flight due to operational reasons, the customer is entitled to: 1. Free rebooking on the next available flight 2. Full cash refund. The customer may choose one of these options.

name: Refund Processing
content: Full refund is available for cancelled flights. Processing time: 7-10 business days. Refunds are processed to the original payment method.

name: Delay Compensation
content: Compensation for flight delays: - Delay > 3 hours: Meal voucher + Lounge access - Delay > 5 hours: Meal voucher + Lounge access + Hotel accommodation. Hotel accommodation is for the delayed period only, not automatically a full night.

name: Fare Difference
content: When a customer requests to move to a higher-fare flight: - Agent approval limit: ₹1,500 - Amounts exceeding ₹1,500 require supervisor approval - Customer may be asked to pay the difference or supervisor may approve the upgrade.

name: Loyalty Tier Benefits
content: Loyalty tier benefits: - Platinum: Priority rebooking, access to premium facilities - Gold: Standard priority rebooking - Silver: Standard benefits. Note: Loyalty status does not create additional compensation beyond standard policies.
